modules.title: Root7 / Number and View Test Suite
modules.summary: Exact and empirical audit surfaces for H/Q state, format invariance, F50, E-Line/Poincare, 11-space residue views and Janus arithmetic mirrors.

modules.title: Readout Reconstruction / OIL-RIS Multi-Lens
modules.summary: Tested custody route from MRB/Pascal carriers through ACR readout and reconstruction controls to the canonical OIL/RIS and P/Q GLB views.
modules.claim_ceiling: The route establishes custody, portable GLB reproduction and bounded representation/reconstruction tests; it does not establish orbital physics, complete source recovery, universal glyph semantics or one physical machine.

modules.title: Roedelheim Observatory Thread Loom
modules.summary: Frozen translation-audit instrument preserved as one byte-identical artifact across reviewer packets.
modules.claim_ceiling: The preserved loom is a review artifact; repeated custody copies are not separate modules.

modules.title: IEEE-300 Graph-to-Grid Validation
modules.summary: A solved IEEE-300 network is converted into local label-independent relations and a fixed moving grid, with topology, relabeling and synthetic-carrier controls.
modules.claim_ceiling: The declared solved IEEE-300 continuation drives the declared relational grid under registered controls; no early-warning, resonance, E8, universality, optimality or utility claim.

surfaces.claim_ceiling: Exact finite block, cube-rotation, projection, Fourier and entropy fixture only; equal projection, Fourier magnitude or entropy does not identify carrier geometry or establish physical Tessarec dynamics.
Exact binary state-lift generator only; the eight carrier states do not establish physical light states, a universal prime code or carrier identity across representations.
Exact finite DFT, carrier-shift and inverse-return fixture only; shifted spectra are coordinate representations and do not establish a physical light channel or universal kappa mechanism.

Bounded documentary synthesis of declared carriers, views, finite arithmetic, Euler-characteristic examples and source relations only; it opens no Study, proves no preferred natural geometry and promotes no physical, historical-intent or universal-operator claim.
Exact modular-arithmetic reconstruction only; equal residues do not identify integer states, and no physical mechanism or new operator is asserted.
Exact affine reflection and modular-residue views only; the Janus geometry is a representation and establishes no physical meaning.
Exact Hamming-weight quotient and Pascal multiplicity fixture only; equal counts such as 56 do not identify operators, and exact return requires the within-fiber ordinal.

Exact trinomial Pascal multiplicity, global antipode and typed number-handle fixture only; the result establishes no Coxeter/E8 identity, physical mechanism, cryptographic selector or base-independent reversal law.

Finite prime-address selector and matched-control audit only; the selector is reproducible but shows no registered coding advantage and establishes no physical, optical, kappa, cryptographic or asymptotic mechanism.
Custody, portable GLB reproduction and bounded multi-view reconstruction only; ACR-42 font-contour rerun remains quarantined and no physical or universal glyph claim is promoted.
Bounded graph-to-grid representation contract only; no warning, prediction, resonance, E8, universal-grid or utility claim.
Preregistered mixed-negative cross-view morphology result only: the common solver boundary is reproduced, while H3 and Circle specificity are not supported and resolution stability fails.

relations.explanation: The embedded LOKI / Green Bridge view provides a declared frame-binding route into the Tessarec carrier family.
relations.claim_boundary: Bridge of representations, not module or mechanism identity.

relations.explanation: Both use bounded views, a declared binder or seam and an explicit return comparison.
relations.claim_boundary: Shared method grammar, not proof that the carriers are the same.

relations.explanation: The observer cut is applied to a separately declared sign-state carrier and returned to a comparison frame.
relations.claim_boundary: Projection grammar only; no automatic physical 4D claim.

relations.explanation: The mutation-family graph now exposes an ordered edge address as trit × direction, yielding six paired states with an explicit antipode and exact base-20/base-6 number views; Primegrid Block 3 remains the cyclic matched-control baseline.
relations.claim_boundary: The representation bridge does not change graph adjacency, identify prime labels with Coxeter weights, transfer Block-3 coding performance, or establish a 42-to-1032 generator.

relations.explanation: Runtime receipts can support Mission Control review while remaining distinct from activation and currentness authority.
relations.claim_boundary: Infrastructure is not governance.

relations.explanation: Incoming Rosetta views reuse cut, frame and return vocabulary but remain unresolved until adoption and typed reconciliation.
relations.claim_boundary: No canonical Rosetta topology or universal QRT operator is inferred.

relations.explanation: The historical two-cuts demonstration is a provenance route into the current bounded Two-Cut instrument.
relations.claim_boundary: Historical custody does not make the incomplete series a current master.

relations.explanation: Phase and loom language create a discoverable comparison route while the translation audit remains frozen.
relations.claim_boundary: Lexical and visual overlap only unless a later test establishes a stronger relation.

relations.explanation: The H/Q format-invariance execution binds the Five-H multi-view phase-and-gate fixture to a bounded Number/View comparison suite.
relations.claim_boundary: A source-bound format test does not establish a universal phase law, carrier identity or physical mechanism.

relations.explanation: The Eleven-Space residue views and Janus affine mirrors instantiate the Antipode method at arithmetic-address level: one carrier, paired or layered views, a declared involution, comparison space and return record.
relations.claim_boundary: The method bridge does not identify nine shells with eleven residue states, nor arithmetic reflection with geographic antipodes, Q-mirror inversion or one physical mechanism.

relations.explanation: The instrument-family binding registers Tessarec Root Space 8-to-16 as one declared projection fixture inside the Number/View audit context.
relations.claim_boundary: Shared projection and comparison grammar does not transfer Q4 carrier identity or evidence between modules.

relations.explanation: The tested Primegrid chain lifts a finite binary carrier, applies an exact DFT shift/return fixture and then projects the state set into Pascal Hamming-weight fibers with an explicit residual address for exact return.
relations.claim_boundary: This closes a navigation and representation loop only; equal cardinalities do not establish operator identity, and the quotient alone is not invertible.

relations.explanation: The bounded Pi/Q mask-compatibility execution uses the preserved Thread Loom contract as a declared source in a Number/View audit.
relations.claim_boundary: Compatibility in the frozen test contract is not operator identity, general translation invariance or scientific promotion.

relations.explanation: ERITH and MIWA are curated as separate instruments within the same Crownpiece release and presentation layer.
relations.claim_boundary: Shared release context and visual grammar do not make the instruments, carriers or mechanisms identical.

relations.explanation: The preserved orientation series and operator package share an orientation-to-action vocabulary and are kept as a discoverable lineage candidate.
relations.claim_boundary: No version succession, reconstruction lineage or current-master status is established by this candidate route.

relations.explanation: The recovered MRB/Pascal records and ACR closure, readout, mixing, projection and residual controls form a typed route from finite carrier addresses into bounded multi-view reconstruction.
relations.claim_boundary: A tested representation route does not identify number, glyph, sound and 3D geometry as one mechanism.

relations.explanation: The OIL/RIS multi-lens audit supplies an abstaining reconstruction gate and the GLB gateway supplies its versioned visual custody objects for Mission Control review.
relations.claim_boundary: Mission Control linkage is navigation and review only; it is not activation authority or a physical-machine validation.

relations.explanation: The IEEE benchmark operationalizes the existing representation-and-return question on a solved network carrier with registered controls.
relations.claim_boundary: Shared method grammar does not identify the IEEE carrier, LIFE engines, scores or experiment sequence.

relations.explanation: The benchmark contributes replayable frames, control receipts and a portable HTML/GIF result surface to the comparison infrastructure.
relations.claim_boundary: Runtime transport and visualization do not promote prediction, mechanism or utility claims.

relations.explanation: No map from IEEE buses, branches, relation rows or grid cells to E8 roots, Cartan data, Weyl generators or Coxeter orbits is defined or tested.
relations.claim_boundary: E8 remains an untested future question, not evidence, likelihood or partial confirmation; LIFE04 and LIFE04B valid-negative specificity results remain unchanged.

relations.explanation: The source-bound six-number gate is retained as 41-42-43 <-> 1031-1032-1033 with h -> h+990, common residues 5-6-7 mod 9, and 1032 = 24 x 43. This exact arithmetic layer does not rescue Morphology 01: Circle rank concordance is rho=0.5 with Holm-adjusted p=1.0, so Circle specificity is not supported.
relations.claim_boundary: The executed Circle overlay remains a valid negative specificity result. The residue match and prime-index labels are typed number-view relations only; they do not establish carrier identity, a preferred geometry, an antipode operator, scientific superiority, or IEEE robustness transfer.

relations.explanation: Morphology 01 executed the exact H3 twelve-channel geometry against matched random rotations. Its observed rank concordance was rho=1.0 but the rotation-null p-value and Holm-adjusted p-value were both 1.0, so H3 specificity was not supported.
relations.claim_boundary: This is a valid negative specificity result. The 12x12 histogram is not thereby a polyhedron, and H3 does not establish E8 or IEEE mechanism identity.

relations.explanation: Morphology 01 now binds the pre-existing mod-9 residue reflection and the 7^2 -> 8^2 persistent-register shell as a typed representation-and-return bridge: 64=49+14+1, map frames may differ, and the registered address remains C2.
relations.claim_boundary: The local residue reflection is structurally compatible with, but not operator-identical to, the global PRIMEGRID antipode without an explicit intertwiner. The 14 register headers and P14=43 are differently typed uses of the same integer; the Rosetta address is not an IEEE carrier.
